title: Strikethrough in Alert List doesn't work correctly
body:
If an alert is disabled in the Alert List it is supposed to become strikethrough. However, in some cases, the strikethrough also appear on other alerts. In the example below, only the 65 and 77 alerts are really disabled.

![Screenshot_20190523-180855_xDrip+](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/34622676/58245515-8bbd3280-7d87-11e9-9693-84ae34848b9e.jpg)

comments.body:
@Hexonium Is this problem still present, or has it been resolved with more recent releases?
Thanks
Still present in the latest version of the nightly channel
I just tested this and cannot reproduce the issue.  Would you please provide more detail helping us see the issue while testing?

I wasn't able to identify a pattern to reproduce the issue. Right now only one line is wrong (the 45), but sometimes there are more. What kind of details would be helpful to you?

![Screenshot_20210212-173829_xDrip+](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/34622676/107795755-588bb580-6d59-11eb-94e8-82a00125bbe6.jpg)

If only one member of the community experiences a problem, it is highly unlikely that anyone would spent the time to address it.
If I can experience the problem first hand, I will be able to either come up with a work-around, or label this as a bug.
So, getting back to your question, can you figure out what you have to do to recreate the problem?
I'll let you know if I find a way to recreate the problem.

Please reopen the issue when you figure out how to recreate the problem.
Thanks
